description: Read an ISO 20022 XML payment message as plain payments and check it. Interprets pain.001 (credit transfer initiation), pain.008 (direct debit), pain.002 and pacs.002 (status reports), pacs.008 (interbank credit transfer), pacs.004 (return), camt.052/053/054 (account reports, statements, notifications) and the business application header, across their published versions. Returns the message type and version, the header facts, each payment or statement entry with parties, amounts and references, totals by currency, and findings: schema violations for the exact version, control sum and transaction count mismatches, IBAN check digits, currency and amount rules, and SEPA rules when the message declares SEPA. Use it instead of reading the XML by eye.

scheme.description: Scheme rules to apply on top of the ISO schema. "auto" applies SEPA rules only when the message declares SEPA.

xml.description: The message as XML text, with or without a business application header or envelope.

name: iso20022_read
title: Read an ISO 20022 payment message
